objective: Program allocation v2 for the live-candidate account (T-20261004-58, plan v2 P4 section 5.8): find a walk-forward, forecast-free sleeve allocation that beats the ETF pilot P0 (0.642 S3 + 0.358 C2, plan v2 D7.1) at the same volatility in both the recent and the stress window, or else the tightest single-sleeve risk-share cap on S3 that costs at most 0.10 recent same-vol Sharpe and helps in stress (owner 10-04 item 3: S3 is ~90% of account risk); then size the selected rule per capital tier (50k/100k/250k/1M USD) and account type (cash, Alpaca margin) under the ~30% drawdown budget (owner 10-02), minimum sleeve capital (T-71 V2) and margin rules, with DSR-deflated simulated drawdown quantiles for the owner.
target_regime_and_horizon: US ETF paper sleeves S1, S2, S3, C2 (plus v1.2 F1/F2 at the 1M tier), daily net returns 2016-01..2026-09-15 (data after 2026-09-17 is the forward holdout and is not used). Decision windows: recent 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 (standard v2 recent_window_start) and stress 2017-10-02..2023-08-31; full 2017-10-02..2026-09-15 for the drawdown budget. Monthly allocation rebalance at five offsets (0,4,8,12,16), judged on the 5-offset blend and the offset median. Horizon: the pilot's life, reviewed monthly.
existing_solution_comparison: Professional multi-sleeve allocation uses risk budgeting rather than return forecasts: equal risk contribution (Maillard-Roncalli-Teiletche 2010) and capped risk budgets, because sample mean-variance loses to 1/N out of sample (DeMiguel-Garlappi-Uppal 2009: none of 14 optimised models consistently beats 1/N). Our current allocation T-43 (2026-10-02) is the opposite: a grid search maximising recent CAGR under a 30% full-window drawdown, which puts ~90% of account risk in S3 (T-75 recomputed: 0.900 recent) and is infeasible at every tier up to 1M USD because the F1/F2 sub-accounts fall below the ~250k minimum (T-71). Nobody publishes an allocation of these particular sleeves, so the comparison has to be run here; the rules themselves are reused from the literature, not invented.
remaining_evidence_gap: (1) Same-vol Sharpe change of CAP2, ERC and IV vs P0 in the recent and stress windows now that C2 (corr 0.42 with S3) exists; (2) whether a cap helps in the six T-75 stress segments and in stress ES; (3) the deployable weights per tier and account type after minimum sleeve capital, margin rules and the drawdown budget; (4) drawdown quantiles after deflating each sleeve's recent Sharpe for selection (DSR haircut; T-20261005-31 supplies ETF sleeve trial counts); (5) the return cost of a cash account vs a margin account for the same rule.
negative_experiments_checked: Registry and local work: dir:paper_sleeve_combination H-20260927-01 refuted 0/3 (S1/S2/S3 mixes vs vol-matched S3, M1 +0.086/-0.001, M2 +0.018/+0.023, M3 +0.294/-0.047 anchor/stress; S2-S3 corr 0.79-0.83) -- reopened only because C2 is new (not in that test, corr 0.42 recent) and because the owner's 10-04 concentration request turns the cap into a priced risk policy (D2) rather than a Sharpe claim; D1 keeps that test's +0.10-in-both-windows bar. T-43 allocation-dd30 (S3 0.60 / C2 0.335 / F1 0.025 / F2 0.12 / borrow 0.08, chosen on the anchor window). T-30 account review (S3 89% of risk, effective bets 1.25; four-sleeve inverse vol + F1 better recent, worse 2018-2023). T-75 concentration (S3 recent 1.58 -> 0.82 without semis ETFs, stress 0.59 -> 0.67; VIX<15 recent cell negative but t about -0.8 after excluding July 2024). Defense-first and cross-asset sleeves are closed by the owner (09-28) and not used.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Sleeve series net of their own costs at 10 bp per side (2x check 20 bp for S1-S3 and C2; v1.2 has no 2x series, stated as a limitation). Allocation rebalance cost 5 bp on the sum of absolute weight changes. Cash earns BIL; margin debit 0.065*365/360 per year on borrowed notional (Alpaca non-elite). Margin feasibility every session on drifted positions: maintenance sum m_i*|pos_i| <= 0.9 equity with m = 0.75 for S3 (3x ETFs, Alpaca table and FINRA RN 09-53), 0.30 for S1/S2/C2 and 0.30 x gross for F1/F2; initial sum max(0.5, m_i)*|pos_i| <= 1.0 at each rebalance; gross <= 2.0. Cash account: gross <= 1.0. Minimum sleeve capital: ETF sleeves 10,000 USD, F1/F2 250,000 USD (T-71); below it the sleeve weight is 0 and the rule is re-solved. Weights use data through the session before the rebalance.
stop_condition: Measurement plus a mechanical rule: d1_replace:<rule> (a rule beats P0 by >= 0.10 same-vol Sharpe in both windows with offsets, placebo and 2x-cost checks), else d2_cap:<c> (tightest admissible cap), else keep_p0. If the identity checks fail, stop before computing any allocation-v2 number. The stage cannot close P4 or any sleeve; it only sets the pilot allocation and the risk-share policy.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Brief T-20261004-58: build the sleeve return panel (S3*/C2*/S1*/S2* from T-32's selected configuration or ORIG, F1/F2 realisation-dated), pass the identity checks against T-43, then evaluate 8 rules x 5 offsets on both windows with placebos and 2x costs, write the mechanical status, size deployables per tier and account type and simulate DSR-deflated drawdown quantiles.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: D1: same-vol excess Sharpe (5-offset blend and median) >= P0 + 0.10 in both the recent and the stress window, >= 4/5 offsets positive (recent), >= 80th percentile of 200 random static weightings (recent), recent change >= 0 at 2x sleeve costs. D2 (if no D1): tightest CAP2 level with recent change >= -0.10, stress change >= -0.05 and a stress benefit (six-segment mean same-vol return +1.0 pp or stress ES97.5 less negative).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No D1 rule and no admissible cap: keep P0 for the pilot, state the concentration as a known risk with T-32's theme limit, and move the 'when to hold semis' rule to P2 stage 2; no further allocation rules are tried on these windows without new sleeves or new data.
